name: Stooq
description: Free daily prices for US stocks, ETFs and a few major indices from Stooq's CSV downloads. A fallback when other providers are rate limited. No key.
terms: Stooq's CSV download is an unofficial public interface without a published API contract. It may change, be rate limited or stop without notice, and its data is not guaranteed complete or real-time. Only US-listed tickers (AAPL, SPY, BRK-B) and the indices ^SPX, ^DJI, ^NDX and ^IXIC are supported. Verify Stooq's terms of use before relying on the data.

provider.label: Stooq
provider.notes: Unofficial daily CSV, not real-time. US tickers only (priced in USD); non-US tickers such as VOLV-B.ST are not supported. Intraday ranges return daily bars.
